public static Order2Selector.Result getOrdersWithoutPayments()

Retrieves all Order2__c records that have not been assigned to any payments. Filters by HasPaymentsAssigned__c = FALSE and orders results by DatabaseCreatedDate__c descending.

Returns:
    Result: Query result containing unassigned orders with fields: Id, Account__c, PayeeId__c, DatabaseCreatedDate__c, NumberOfItems__c, SubtotalAmount__c, TotalTax__c, TotalAmount__c
